tagline: Project board — features flow left→right through the pipeline. Edit this file (docs/board.json) and run tools/render_dashboard.py to update both DASHBOARD.md and dashboard.html.

stages.label: Ideation
stages.desc: A half-baked idea; can be pushed further down once fleshed out.

stages.label: Design
stages.desc: Detailed requirements captured; a spec exists in docs/features/.

stages.label: Implementation
stages.desc: Being built on the dev branch.

stages.label: Testing
stages.desc: Built; waiting for you to try it.

stages.label: Refinement
stages.desc: Tested but not yet approved; new instructions → back to Implementation.

stages.label: Integration
stages.desc: Approved; merging dev → main (prod) + updating docs.

items.title: Themed 6-factor allocation model
items.notes: PEG / EV-EBITDA / Debt-FCF / P-E (cheaper⇒higher) + log avg market cap + price momentum; adjustable weights (20/20/20/15/10/15); 30% per-theme cap; equal-weight within theme.

items.title: Bad / missing data handling
items.notes: Reported-negative ⇒ penalty (prem); not-applicable (banks) ⇒ quality carry-over (qual); missing-but-computable ⇒ derive from TTM statements (calc); manual cell overrides (ovr).

items.title: Free live-data layer (Yahoo)
items.notes: No keys. Quotes + fundamentals, ~15s/6h caching, embedded seed fallback. Web via server.py proxy; iOS on-device via CapacitorHttp.

items.title: Calculator / Rebalance
items.notes: Build initial · full rebalance (buys+sells) · cash-only · realign-only; self-funding (net = cash added).

items.title: Version history (undo/redo/revert)
items.notes: Every build/rebalance is a checkpoint snapshotting holdings + settings + theme membership; git-style fork.

items.title: Prices tab
items.notes: Live prices grouped by theme; per-theme value & weight once a portfolio exists.

items.title: Screener tab
items.notes: Top ~50 by live market cap per theme, mutually exclusive across themes; curated universe (tools/build_universe.py).

items.title: Swap a stock in
items.notes: Tap a screener stock ⇒ replace a same-theme holding ⇒ full realign ⇒ Apply & save (undoable checkpoint).

items.title: Dynamic theme membership
items.notes: state.themeTickers (persisted + snapshotted); tickersOf / membership / tradeUniverse. Foundation the E1 epic builds on.

items.title: Cross-platform: web + iOS
items.notes: One www/ codebase; platform-agnostic data layer; Capacitor iOS wrapper; LAN sync; .native UI skin. (iOS build is the Mac's domain.)

items.title: Data-driven theme list (foundation)
items.notes: state.themes replaces the hardcoded THEMES; engine + all tabs iterate it; 30% cap & 20% equal-weight base derive from N themes; persisted + version-snapshotted + migration. Invisible & regression-safe (defaults to the current 5).

items.title: Add / remove a single ticker in a theme
items.notes: Generalize Swap into independent add & remove primitives + minimal UI.

items.title: Ticker search & validate
items.notes: Search any symbol (even outside the curated universe) → validate via Yahoo → preview → add to a chosen theme.

items.title: Create a new theme
items.notes: Name + colour; appears across all tabs; starts empty.

items.title: Rename / recolour a theme
items.notes: Edit a theme's name and colour.

items.title: Delete a theme / delete-all / restore defaults
items.notes: Removing a theme makes its held names exiting positions (liquidate on realign). Plus reset-to-default-5.

items.title: Similar-stock recommendations
items.notes: For any theme (esp. custom), recommend names similar to its picks. Likely method: live sector/industry-peer expansion via Yahoo, ranked by the 6-factor model (works free on web AND on-device iOS). Method to be finalized at design.
